headline: Elastic Shares Tumble Following Disappointing Revenue Outlook
summary: Shares of search and observability software provider Elastic slumped sharply after the company released a revenue forecast that missed Wall Street projections.
why: Elastic is a critical search and data analytics platform whose software is widely adopted in enterprise cloud and cybersecurity infrastructure.

impacts.name: Elastic N.V.
impacts.why: Weak forward sales guidance prompted institutional investors to downgrade growth expectations and sell shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Elastic shares sold off sharply after its future revenue guidance fell short of analyst forecasts.
